                    MACHINE_IA_64, MACHINE_SPARC, MACHINE_M68K, MACHINE_M88K, MACHINE_MIPS,
                    MACHINE_PPC, MACHINE_S370, MACHINE_S390, MACHINE_ARM, MACHINE_VAX,
